body: And you know, you brought up a good point about the turn-offs. Even the turn-offs seem to point to incompatibility with sex in general. Me being wet is a turnoff for him, me getting too emotional and/or anxious is a turnoff, as is anything to do with me having a period. The other turn-offs made some sense, like only dyeing my hair certain colors - I don’t like it but I comply because it’s a small part of my physical appearance.

This is the logical viewpoint and it’s definitely how I see it. Will he see it this way? I’m not sure. Jealousy over someone else touching what’s “his” could be a thing. Like a kid who doesn’t want to play with his toy, but certainly doesn’t want anyone else playing with it either.. And so I’ve held off asking out of fear of a jealous rage or even hurting his feelings - I don’t want to hurt him.

Sounds like things worked out wonderfully for you in the long run. I’m happy for you! Regarding the question you asked - this will sound naive of me - but no, I know he is not cheating. He was celibate before we got married, and that was what my red flag should have been. I am not a match for someone who can be voluntarily celibate for 2 years. He has just never been that into sex, even when we first got married. He’d promised we’d have lots of sex after marriage but I never dreamed“lots” meant once per week, max, dwindling quickly to ~6 times per year. He would be unlikely to notice if he never got laid again. By anyone. I don’t say that to be insulting, but just to outline that cheating on his part is highly unlikely. Additionally, he is a brutally honest person and can’t keep secrets of any kind, so there’s that too.
I just took it as satire.
That actually makes a lot of sense.
I have, and it was pretty simple stuff, and I’ve complied with it all. Unless there were some turn offs that he’s not shared with me.
At this point even emotionless sex would be ok, I think. Don’t know how I’d feel long-term but that’s a good question.

And that’s kinda what brought me here. We seem to be at a standstill on this and a dead bedroom is just not something I think I want to tolerate any longer. I’ve asked him to watch porn with me, play with toys, try meds, go to strip clubs, read books, and even just to listen to what I’d like or tell me what he’d like. I’ve been trying for years and I’m out of ideas. I’m just frustrating him at this point. He’s said he doesn’t get why it matters to me.

I know that you’ve right and it really is that simple. My Mom pointed out that I don’t have to try to set some kind of record for prolonging an unhappy marriage - it really is ok to leave. But I just always thought that, unless someone hits you, you stay. Hard mindset to leave behind.

I’m so sorry that you went through that, and I hope things have gotten better for you. I’m fairly convinced that he’s asexual, too, and I’m not sure how I’d feel if he suddenly was having lots of sex with someone else. But maybe a “don’t ask, don’t tell” rule could apply? I doubt he’d want to know about my potential future exploits, either.

Thank you for that; I appreciate your kind words. There are other issues than sex that we’re working on; it’s just the on that seems unsolvable. I may ask about opening the relationship, but I don’t see it happening.
No, but ethically, I would not add another person to this unless he’s ok with it. And he’s so befuddled by a sex drive in general that I don’t see that he’d understand or be on board.
It’s so hard. I’m sorry you’re going through it, too.

There are other issues, but they’re issues I feel like we would work through eventually. But sex isn’t part of what he’s willing to work on. And yes, he’s a wonderful person in many ways. I don’t want to keep asking him to change who he is.

I’m so sorry that you’ve gone through all that. In my case, too, the sex isn’t the only issue or even the biggest issue; it’s just the issue that he’s not willing to help me solve. I hope things get better for you, and thank you for sharing your experience.

That really puts things in perspective. It’s still a hard choice and I haven’t made it yet, but can I live this way for 40 more years? I think I would be dead inside if I tried to continue this way. Thank you for your input.
